source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Generate SEL in SUT firstly.
2. Enter BIOS -> Server Mgmt page -> View System Event Logs, and then check current SEL.
2. Enter BIOS -> Server Mgmt page -> System Event Logs, set "Erase SEL" to "Yes, On next reset", and then save & exit.
4. Enter BIOS -> Server Mgmt page -> View System Event Logs, and then check SEL should be erased.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Information of SEL should be correct.
2. SEL can be erased successfully.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- OS installation is a long, interactive multi-step process (boot install media, answer installer prompts, reboot). After the user provides the OS install image + desired partitioning/credentials, agent can drive an unattended/preseed install and verify boot. This is not a one-line command; discuss exact install steps after the media is prepared.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL unattended-install log + final `uname -a`/boot confirmation so the user confirms the OS boots and is usable after install.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: OS install wipes/repartitions the boot disk and reboots the host; back up data, confirm image + target disk, and schedule a maintenance window.

original_test_intent: Generate a known System Event Log record, visually verify it in BIOS Server Mgmt, schedule Erase SEL for the next reset, and visually verify that the same SEL is erased afterward.
original_method: Archive the full SEL, generate an approved event, compare the independent BMC SEL with the BIOS page, set Erase SEL to Yes, On next reset, save/exit and reset, then verify the cleared state through both BIOS and BMC paths.
manual_activity: A human must view the SEL on the named BIOS page, set the erase-on-next-reset option, save/exit, and re-enter BIOS to observe the cleared state. Automated BMC SEL collection corroborates but cannot replace those core UI observations.
required_inputs: Approved SEL stimulus and expected record fields
OOB recovery route and project script revision
safety_requirements: Archive the complete pre-clear SEL before setting Erase SEL.
Use only an approved non-damaging event stimulus.
Obtain one-authorized-user approval for the unchanged destructive-clear/reset plan and drain workloads.
Do not run the contaminated OS-install guidance or alter any disk.
Stop on target ambiguity, unexpected event severity, boot failure or loss of BMC/console access.
agent_execution_scope: Collect full read-only BMC SEL, platform identity and OS/BMC health before and after approval.
Correlate the approved stimulus and timestamps with operator-supplied BIOS captures.
Package discrepancies and evidence without claiming the manual observation or final verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the event stimulus, erase/reset and evidence retention plan.
Perform/capture the BIOS view, Erase SEL selection, save/reset and post-reset view.
Classify unexpected records and decide PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: it describes OS installation and destructive disk work from the duplicate-code row 1481.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the preserved project SEL script and full read-only ipmitool sel elist/list output only after version review; do not truncate the pre-clear archive and do not replace the BIOS view.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS paths, Yes, On next reset value, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a complete independent BMC SEL baseline, inject one documented event, correlate record ID/sensor/type/timestamp with the BIOS page, then capture both paths after the approved next-reset clear.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, ipmitool and project-script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS/BMC SEL specification and approved event-generation SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full independent archival and field-level correlation without changing the BIOS erase workflow.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SEL record rendering can differ between BIOS and ipmitool; approved normalization is required.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose a safe stimulus and retention/reset window, but may not substitute OS installation, omit the BIOS view, or claim a truncated/independent log alone proves the UI clear behavior.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, approved plan and full pre-clear BMC SEL
Stimulus output and expected SEL fields
BIOS System Event Logs capture showing the generated record
Erase SEL Yes, On next reset and save/reset evidence
Post-reset BIOS and independent BMC evidence showing clear state
